comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Every item is limited to 25 attack points and 25 defense. The key to achieving high numbers is to take items that begin with naturally high stats and use a combination of UWC forging tools and Transmutation Alchemy with Unicorn books to boost their power to its maximum level.

Naturally, UWC armors and weapons have vastly better base stats than obtainable items in UWO, so if you plan to aim for the top tier, expect to spend a lot of money (real life and in-game ducats) to accomplish your goal.

Also, there are three other auras:

Light Blue (atk/def related; don't recall the stats needed to trigger it)
Light Pink (same as above; new to the game and is the highest atk/def glow possible)
Gold (limited to those who wear/layer a full outfit from the white Sheriff clothing sets for men and women)

All glows are pretty much cosmetic, it's just that they (apart from Gold) indicate the player's max atk/def rating. Hope that helps. Cheers.
